create_token_stats: create a TokenStats pipeline step to compute token counts for documents using a specified tokenizer
run_token_stats: run the TokenStats pipeline step on a document stream to extract per-document token statistics
extract_token_stats: extract token count statistics from a Document object using the TokenStats extract_stats method
configure_tokenizer: configure a TokenStats instance with a custom tokenizer name or path for token counting
compute_grouped_stats: compute grouped token statistics by fqdn, suffix, summary, and histogram groups
